body.x: The ‘CES 2025 Pangyo Lunch Talk,’ an event to share the achievements and insights of CES 2025 Pangyo Techno Valley participants, will be held on February 20. The event showcases innovative technologies and industry trends from CES participant companies, providing Pangyo businesses with opportunities to explore global market expansion.

At CES 2025, seven of the 19 top Innovation Award winners were Korean companies, and Korean firms developed 163 out of 354 awarded products. Given the increasing recognition of Korean, particularly Pangyo-based, companies on the global stage, the ‘Pangyo Lunch Talk’ aims to highlight the achievements of CES participants while fostering networking between investors and businesses.

The event will take place on Thursday, February 20, from 11:30 AM to 1:00 PM at ‘The Link’ on the second floor of the Gyeonggi Startup Campus. It is jointly organized by the Gyeonggido Business and Science Accelerator (GBSA) and AVING NEWS. Around 50 representatives from CES participant companies and Pangyo-based businesses are expected to attend, with pre-registration open until February 17. Interested participants can apply through the Pangyo Techno Valley website under the Archive - Support Programs - Pangyo Techno Valley Support Programs section.

Attendees will gain insights into the latest technology trends and market movements from CES participants and explore industry collaboration opportunities through regular networking programs. Additionally, the event is expected to leverage the Pangyo TV channel to enhance domestic and international publicity.
The event will feature presentations from CES 2025 Innovation Awards Honorees, including UNIUNI Corp. (CEO Sooyeon Han), AramHUVIS (CEO Dongsoon Park), and MEDIAIPLUS (CEO JiHee Jung).

UNIUNI developed the ‘SAVVY Accessible Restroom,’ a deep-learning solution ensuring restroom safety and privacy for individuals with disabilities, earning recognition at CES 2025. AramHUVIS leads the smart healthcare sector with its AI-powered personalized scalp care solutions. MEDIAIPLUS has created ‘MeA,’ a chatbot providing customized clinical trial information for patients and researchers, facilitating the expansion of global clinical trials.

CES 2025 served not just as a technology exhibition but as a platform shaping the future of industries. The ‘CES 2025 Pangyo Lunch Talk’ will catalyze Pangyo companies to take on a more proactive role in the global innovation ecosystem. The networks and collaborations initiated in Pangyo are expected to expand globally, paving the way for significant advancements.

Pangyo Techno Valley serves as a global R&D hub, integrating Research (R), People (P), Information (I), and Trade (T) across IT, BT, CT, NT, and mobility sectors. It is a leading innovation cluster in Gyeonggi-do, established to drive technological innovation, talent development, job creation, and international business competitiveness.

The Gyeonggido Business and Science Accelerator’s Techno Valley Innovation Headquarters has continuously promoted Pangyo Techno Valley’s value by hosting events such as ‘Pangyo Evening Meet-Up,’ ‘Pan-Pan Day,’ and ‘Pangyo Startup Investment Exchange In-Best Pangyo.’ These initiatives have facilitated networking between Pangyo companies, domestic and international investors, and the media. Similar events are planned for this year to support the growth and global expansion of Pangyo startups through various assistance programs.
